full_prompt_en: A square stylized painting arranges three elongated figures close together around a pale cup against muted teal and ocher vertical planes. At the center back, a tall figure in a dark flat-topped hat looks slightly right. The long golden face has a narrow nose and half-lowered eyes, with warm shadow running down one side. A dark green garment occupies the lower middle. On the left, a second figure with a pale cream head covering turns toward the center. A thin rust-red band follows the edge of the covering above a long, simplified face, and a strong rust-orange garment fills the lower-left corner. On the right, a third figure in a large angular pale hood faces left. A brown curve of hair appears near the ear, and a teal outer garment descends along the lower right. The three faces overlap in a compact triangular grouping, their small red lips and heavy-lidded eyes sharing a calm, distant expression. A simple light-colored cup with a short handle sits at the bottom center, partly cropped by the frame. At far right, a narrow golden stalk-like decorative form rises against a pale panel. The background is divided into large vertical blocks of beige, turquoise, brown, and gold rather than a realistic room. The paint surface is matte and subtly grainy, with smoothly shaded internal planes and extremely clean angular edges. Light appears soft and even, giving the warm faces gentle volume without cast shadows. The overall composition is intimate and geometric, balancing tall tapered profiles, broad head coverings, and one small light object within a restrained warm-cool palette.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形风格化绘画把三名修长人物紧密排列在一只浅色杯子周围，背景是灰青和赭黄的竖向平面。中央后方，一名戴深色平顶帽的高个人物略向右望。长长的金色脸部有窄鼻和半垂眼睛，一侧纵贯暖色阴影。深绿色衣服占据下部中央。左侧，第二名戴浅奶油色头巾的人转向中心。一道细锈红边沿头巾轮廓越过简化的长脸，强烈锈橙色衣服填满左下角。右侧，第三名戴宽大有角浅色头罩的人朝左。耳旁露出一道棕色发弧，青绿色外衣沿右下垂落。三张面孔以紧凑三角形互相遮叠，小小红唇与半垂眼神传达同样平静、遥远的表情。一只带短柄的简洁浅色杯子置于下部中央，被画边部分截断。最右侧，一道狭长金色穗状装饰形态在浅色平面前升起。背景被分成米色、青绿、棕色和金色的大块竖向区域，而非写实房间。颜料表面哑光且有细微颗粒，内部平面塑影平顺，棱角边缘却极为干净。光线柔和均匀，让暖色面庞有温和体积，没有投影。整体构图亲密而几何化，在克制冷暖色盘中平衡高而渐尖的侧脸、宽阔头罩与一件小浅色物体。
style_prompt_en: The matte painting simplifies forms into elongated vertical planes, tapered angles, and broad curved caps of color. Warm ocher, rust, cream, olive, and muted teal occupy balanced blocks, with small red accents concentrated near the visual center. Edges are clean and architectural in their geometry, yet softly shaded transitions within each plane provide quiet volume. A fine, even grain keeps the flat colors from appearing perfectly digital. Several tall shapes overlap in shallow space, forming a compact central knot above one small pale accent; broad vertical bands behind them maintain calm order. Light is diffuse and frontal, with gradual internal value changes rather than hard cast shadow or glossy reflection. Repeated narrow points contrast with rounded upper arcs and wider lower masses. The overall effect is poised and ornamental, with elegant proportion, disciplined area color, and minimal detail carrying the character of the image.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅哑光绘画把形体简化为修长竖向平面、渐尖角形和宽阔弯曲的色彩上沿。暖赭、锈红、奶油色、橄榄绿与灰青色组成平衡的色块，小红色重音集中在视觉中心附近。边缘的几何形态干净而规整，但每个平面内部柔和的明暗过渡提供安静体积。均匀细颗粒让平坦颜色不显得完全数字化。几道高形体在浅空间中重叠，于一处小浅色重音上方形成紧凑中心结点；后方宽阔竖向条带维持平静秩序。光线漫射且偏正面，依靠内部缓慢明度变化，而非硬投影或光亮反射。反复的狭窄尖角与圆润上弧、更宽的下部团块形成对照。整体效果从容且有装饰感，由优雅比例、受约束的色彩面积和极少细节塑造图像性格。
theme_en: Three elongated figures gathered around a pale cup
theme_zh: 三名修长人物围在一只浅色杯子旁
name: Fabio Hurtado
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
